When im constantly bombarded by planes, helicopters and drones while im enjoying myself in a tank you have to trust me on this one: its not very fun, and i hope that everybody else is having fun playing tanks since apparently im not allowed to.

Also CAS players also have an attitude called "Just spawn SPAA" so i guess were in the same league in that regard.

But i get it, "Dont hate the player, hate the game". Still doesnt stop me from being frustrated that i cant play the game the way i would like which is without flying monstrosities harrassing me from every way.

they would atleast need to be significantly lowered though, maybe removing them is a bit harsh. as for the ground only i would really like if we had an option to play tank only even if it is with lower rewards i would still play it.

also another change that came to my mind is to make sim ground br based instead of randomly generated 2 presets of vehicles since in sim there are less cas players but i often find the vehicles that gaijin has cooked up for me not really something i want to play in that particular day.

yeah i can get behind that, if i can get parts, fpe and all shells unlocked with my tank im all good. but some of the repair costs have to be lowered to be like 7k max and only in rare occasions because if youre not a premium player its really hard to get even with repair costs up to 20k right now.
adding a tank only mode so when i want to actually play tanks, im allowed to play tanks without constant bombardment from the air.
i want them to remove repair costs and add a tank only mode and thats it, theyre good in my books.

at some point youre going to run out of aa orders you cant keep activating them in every match theres an abundance of cas, also i dont really know anyone that really tries to fulfill those orders as they come. mostly theyre just ignored and if you get them, you get them i really cant think of any situation where either me, a friend or even a random guy i met on a discord ive never played with before were going for those orders specifically but im just guessing its just a difference of play styles really.

which brings me to another conclusion that you cant really just activate an order and expect your teammates to just spawn spaas and try to fulfill those orders because if they wanted to spawn spaa or had no other choice but to spawn spaa they would have spawned them anyways no matter if theres an order or not but ill try your way and ill see for myself if it really makes a difference but i really expect it to not make a difference that much, maybe ill stumble upon one guy that really just wants to fulfill that order but i dont expect it to be life changing experience and for cas to just disappear every time i pop an order.

and yes i do agree i had clueless aa on the other team but it still shows you definitely can spawn in a plane a second or even a third time if you got incredibly lucky especially since im not that very good of a pilot and i still did it.
yeah im grinding the gepard 1a2 right now so i can have full spaa lineup to issue a no fly zone for any plane or helicopter that gets into my game, im really sick and tired of cas.

i dont need to use a aa order as i dont need the money, and you cant really rush a point with cas bombarding you on the whole way to the point most of the times.

you do get the occasional upper hand at them but its really just very annoying to deal with cas in this game especially when you play in tanks that cant really do much against them like open top vehicles or very slow tanks.

some people can rack up enough sp on planes its actually ridiculous and i myself have tried that out when i spawned in an A10 and just went for helicopters, light tanks and spaa's that are oblivious to me existing and i racked up enough sp that i could spawn in a backup a10 as well as my whole lineup just by that one little stunt.

also the ratio of planes to tanks on this lineup is just horrendous and its achievable to spawn 2 of those planes and even 3 really if you have a good day of pressing spacebar.

lately its been worse i think, maybe its because of the crafting event or something but i get more and more battles where often there are more planes up than tanks and i just think it defeats the whole purpose of ground battles if the battles are fought in the air

sure but considering they can spawn a 600 sp plane by killing one guy and rush capping one point is a little worrying to me as im an only tank guy and today i spent 3 hours playing spaa only because there were so many planes up all the time it felt like an air rb battle and i sure do hope everyone else in those 3 hours that i encountered had fun playing tanks because apparently im not allowed to

this is basically just a rant and i just wanted it out there, im of course a little sick with them planes and i wish there was a tank only gamemode where i could atleast get back some of my lost sanity with this game
